$comment: xo-stylesheet.vite-plugin.js — which *.global.scss files go into the {% stylesheet %} tag of their own liquid (Shopify bundles per page render tree) and which stay in the shared CSS file. Paths are relative to the theme root. exclude: HTML that arrives via AJAX (quick view, Section Rendering API, predictive search) is not in the initial render tree, so its CSS MUST stay shared. cssStyle: "expanded" (default, readable CSS inside the liquid) or "compressed".
